step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS differential pair with a tail current source. In the context of a 10-Gb/s transceiver, this topology is typically used as a high-speed amplifier, buffer, or as the core of a Current Mode Logic (CML) gate.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the differential pair stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail * VDD. With VBIAS=1.0V, I_tail ≈ 0.45mA. Power = 0.45mA * 1.8V = 0.81mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical bias current for a small differential pair in SKY130.

tail_current.description: DC bias current provided by the tail current source (XM3).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the VBIAS voltage and the dimensions of XM3.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * RL. gm ≈ 1.1mA/V (at Id=0.225mA). With added RL=2kOhm, Gain = 2.2 V/V = 6.8 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor and bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2 * pi * RL * CL). With RL=2kOhm and CL=10fF, BW ≈ 7.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC time constant of the output node. Adjusted for a generic load to demonstrate high-speed capability.

tran_vout_pp.description: Peak-to-peak differential output voltage for a 400mVpp differential input at 100MHz.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Transient large-signal swing, limited by tail current and load resistors (I_tail * RL = 0.9V max swing).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, tail current, differential AC gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the differential pair. Ideal load resistors and capacitors are added to make the circuit functional.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Differential Pair
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N2 IN N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 IN_HASH N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Loads (Added for testbench functionality)
RL1 VDD N2 2k
RL2 VDD N3 2k
CL1 N2 0 10f
CL2 N3 0 10f

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 1.0

* Input Signal Generation (Common Mode + Differential Mode)
VCM VCM 0 0.9
VDM VDM 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.2 100MEG)
E1 IN VCM VDM 0 0.5
E2 IN_HASH VCM VDM 0 -0.5

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let itail = -i(VVDD)
  let power = itail * 1.8
  print itail power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1MEG 100G
  let vout_diff = v(N2) - v(N3)
  let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1MEG
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n
  let vout_diff_tran = v(N2) - v(N3)
  meas tran vout_max max vout_diff_tran from=10n to=20n
  meas tran vout_min min vout_diff_tran from=10n to=20n
  let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
  print vout_pp
  
  quit
.endc
.end
